goal: Take the legacy run's winning quicksort (evolved from bubble sort, ~45% faster baseline, run-2025-12-11_21-27-18) to absurd speeds while preserving exact sorted-output behavior. Push beyond the legacy winner on: Hoare/Lomuto partitioning tricks, pivot selection (median-of-three, ninther), insertion-sort cutoff tuning, tail-call elimination, typed-array replacements, branchless swaps, predication, and bytecode-level wins for V8. Algorithmic wins dominate; micro-traps (Int32Array stacks, manual swap inlining) were proven dead ends in the legacy run — revisit them only if the benchmark proves it. Constraints: no built-in Array.prototype.sort, in-place destructive sorting, must handle negatives, floats, heavy duplicates, and adversarial orderings fast.
